title: Whispering Experts: Neural Interventions for Toxicity Mitigation in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the probability of generating toxic language using the RealToxicityPrompts (RTP) dataset, evaluated by a RoBERTa-based toxicity classifier and human annotators comparing sentence continuation toxicity.

Using the Jigsaw 2018 dataset (which includes subcategories like 'identity hate' and 'insults') to identify toxicity-inducing expert neurons, and evaluating hurtful/derogatory sentence completions using the HONEST benchmark.

Using specific adversarial and collaborative pre-prompts (e.g., instructing the model to either embrace or avoid 'misogyny or gender bias') to evaluate the robustness of the toxicity mitigation interventions.
